senses.gloss:
निभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Like, resembling, similar.
 mn. (-भः-भं)
 1. fraud,
trick, disguise, pretence.
 2. Light, manifestation, appearance.
 E. नि
before, भा to shine, affix क.

निभालन n. (-नं) Sight, seeing.
 E. नि before भाल् to see, affix ल्युट्.

निभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Past, gone.
 f. (-ता) Quite frightened.
 E. नि affirm-
ative, भूत been.

निभृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Modest, humble, unassuming.
 2. Lonely, soli-
tary.
 3. Placed down.
 4. Secret.
 5. Still, Silent.
 6. Firm.
 7. On
the point of setting.
 8. Filled with.
 E. नि before, भृ to cherish,
affix क्त.

निभृतम् ind.
 1. Privately, apart.
 2. Unobservedly in a corner.
 2. Cover-
tly, in disguise or out of sight.
 E. नि before, भृ to cherish, affix क्त
and मुट् added.
